text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Satono Crown! It's Satono Crown!
Satono Crown conquers the battle in the rain!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sullied in mud yet shining with noble majesty, the one and only Crown!
Satono Crown magnificently conquers the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
(Ooooohhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
Guh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
U-U-U-U-Ugh...
Uuuuughhhhhh~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh, aaaaaaahhh!!

Piercing through even the heavily clouded sky,
Kitasan Black's roar echoes across the field.
And so, she—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Kura-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet... Not yet, not yet!!
The festival isn't over just yet!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I won't let it end...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Please. At the Japan Cup!
Race against me next time, there!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Now then, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I mean...
The Japan Cup is 2,400 meters, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"And you're better at longer distances.
More so than me, that is."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh. O-Oh, right.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: At this rate, challenging her to a rematch on conditions disadvantageous to Cla-chan would just be—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why—I'm confident!
I accept your challenge, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just because it's your best distance,
you shouldn't let your guard down, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The more disadvantageous the situation, the stronger I become.
The higher the wall, the thicker it is, the more my power surges!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup.
Let's meet again there, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, goodness...!
Those girls are just simply irresistible!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
That's so true!!
Man, what intense passion...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Starting from a place where nobody paid much attention, working hard and hard, climbing straight to the top.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"And then, there was one girl who
finally clawed her way to the center of the era—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
However, she meets that gritty, unrefined power
and challenge head-on, taking it solidly...
and then, repels it completely.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And there were even absurdly elite Umamusume among them.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Clashing together, honing each other, growing stronger...
Running more and more thrilling races!
After seeing something like that... how could I not get hyped?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...I can't help but feel exhilarated...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Right before my eyes, flames are burning.
They are sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Her heat... is reaching me.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It spreads.
...It's contagious.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I want to win."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I want to win."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "I want to win"...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Aaaah!!
There you are, Cheval-chi~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because you suddenly went down!
Wait, eek~! I'm soaking wet?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine.
Don't make a big fuss over it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly, Vivlos.
...You too, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I have... a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's the matter, Cheval?
Why so formal all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Watch... my run.
And tell me what you think.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Those two... they have so, so many things that I lack.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Things I couldn't have noticed on my own.
...Where I'm still lacking in training,
I'm sure I'll discover so much of that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
L... Lend me...
...your strength, please!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...!
Cheval, you—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Big sis. Vivlos.
I'm—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm running in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, didn't you notice?
...The sound of rain has stopped.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it'll be sunny for the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to it, Trainer.
